presets.instruction: Draft a reply in my voice from this gist.
presets.label: Reply

presets.instruction: Draft a polite refusal; use my reason if I gave one.
presets.label: Decline

presets.instruction: Summarize in three lines: who, what is asked, by when. Post it as the result.
presets.label: Summarize

presets.instruction: Explain the context from the vault and past mail: who this is, what came before. Post it as the result.
presets.label: Explain

presets.instruction: Review this draft before I approve it: spelling and grammar (fix them in the draft), an attachment the text mentions but the draft lacks, a question from the mail it answers that it leaves unanswered, wrong names or dates. Post what you found as the result; change nothing beyond spelling and grammar.
presets.label: Review

presets.instruction: Turn this mail into a Plane task or a vault note, whichever fits; post the link as the result.
presets.label: Task

presets.instruction: Draft a forward to the person named, with a short cover line.
presets.label: Forward
